title: John the Baptist
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains Luke 3:3-14: John preaches repentance and baptism, tells people to bear fruit that shows repentance, the crowd to share coats and food, tax collectors to take no more than required, soldiers not to extort and to be content.

floor.prerequisite: Knows John prepared the way for Jesus.
floor.question: What was John's work, according to Luke 1:76?
floor.answer: To prepare the way for the Lord

representations: a chart: who asked, what John said
two coats drawn on the board
steps: The crowd: share coats and food.
Tax collectors: no more than required.
contexts: a traffic officer who refuses a bribe

board.do: Draw a chart with three rows: crowd, tax collectors, soldiers.
Wait for the child to say collect no more than required.

misconceptions.ask: What did John the Baptist mean by repentance?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 3:8, "bear fruits that befit repentance".

listen_for: Collect more than you are ordered to
misconceptions.ask: What did John tell the tax collectors?
What did John tell people who had two coats?
What did John tell the soldiers (Luke 3:14)?
misconceptions.repair: Make a chart: crowd, tax collectors, soldiers, and what John told each. None was told to leave.

checks.question: What did John tell people with two coats?
checks.answer: Share with one who has none

checks.question: What is repentance, as John taught?
checks.answer: Turning from wrong and living a changed life
